measurements.name: dispersion pearson r
measurements.method: Eigenvector-seeded 1D PDE growth versus analytical σ(k) at 18 wavenumbers
measurements.source: Turing 1952 dispersion relation; identity would be r=1

measurements.name: dispersion KS statistic
measurements.method: scipy.stats.ks_2samp on analytical versus PDE-measured σ(k)
measurements.source: Zero only if the two curves are the same sample
measurements.note: Curve discrepancy, not a calibrated p-value

measurements.name: most unstable wavenumber from the PDE
measurements.source: k_c = (det/(Du Dv))^0.25 is the band-center formula, not always argmax σ
measurements.note: The small shift is reported rather than forced to zero

measurements.name: ocellus stripe wavelength
measurements.method: Parabolic-refined radial FFT peak of the final activator, times ell
measurements.source: Assigned detail scale 0.0002006 m (201 µm label)
measurements.note: predicted λ_m at Dv=20 is 0.0002006 m by construction of ell

measurements.name: specimen image bell circularity
measurements.method: Largest body in the bright mask after dropping arms thinner than 8 px, then dilating back
measurements.source: A perfect circle would score 1. The central medusa is a side view with a residual margin, so the outline is not a circle.
measurements.note: Non-circular specimen metric. Pass 1 ragged mask scored 0.328.

measurements.name: specimen image foreground fraction
measurements.method: Border-median contrast mask on the full CC0 photograph
measurements.source: Occupancy gate used by verify_image_fitness (0.32 saturates the occupancy term)
measurements.note: Measured on the photograph, not copied from the simulation

measurements.name: specimen image structure coherency
measurements.method: Mean structure-tensor coherency inside the photograph foreground
measurements.source: Same operator on the final Schnakenberg field
measurements.note: Specimen versus simulation; the two images are different objects

measurements.name: specimen contour gonad lobes
measurements.method: Angular peaks in the upper-right oral bell, which is clipped by the top edge of the frame
measurements.source: Aurelia has four gonads (visible as a clover on oral views). Eight rhopalia are a different count and are not the reference here.
measurements.note: Measured peak count versus the anatomical four. The frame crops the bell, so the count can miss an arc.

measurements.name: spot diameter CV
measurements.method: std/mean of equivalent diameters of activator peaks
measurements.source: A pure single-mode sinusoid has no diameter scatter; nonlinear spots do

measurements.name: Dv-sweep wavelength pearson r
measurements.method: Predicted λ(Dv) versus FFT λ(Dv) at Dv in {12,16,20,28,36,48}
measurements.source: k_c(Dv) = (det/(Du Dv))^0.25 with ell fixed at the 201 µm node
measurements.note: Six Dv values. The Dv=48 point sits slightly below the curve because the radial bin is still coarse.
